title: Spectral Abilities
description: Transform into a ghost with cool superpowers
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d66dc02ef7a6e934d98f8c04f3e1ef9e32e49b77.png)

🎃 **Unleash the Spirit Within!** 🎃 

**Current ongoing version - MC 1.21.7**

Get ready to embrace the spine-tingling magic of Halloween as the veil between our world and the spirit realm grows thin. Ghostly whispers and eerie shadows come alive on this bewitching night. As the moon ascends and the night falls into an eerie silence, we embark on a spine-tingling journey into getting spectral abilities that may just send shivers down your spine. 🌙👻✨  


## Description
This datapack will allow you to gain spectral abilities such as transforming into a ghost, possession or even flying.


## Ritual
To gain the spectral abilities you have to do a ritual :  

**First create the altar:**  
- white_candle x4  
- black_candle x4  
- amethyst_block x12  
- chiseled_quartz_block x1  

After creating the altar, you will have to drag one mob (see list below).  

**List of the mob**  
- drowned  
- evoker  
- husk  
- pillager  
- skeleton  
- stray  
- vex  
- vindicator  
- witch  
- wither_skeleton  
- zoglin  
- zombie  
- zombie_villager  

And drop a nether star on it.  
Once done the ritual will be completed and you will have gained spectral abilities.  


## Abilities

### Form Normal

| Abilities     | Cost | Description                                                                 | Cooldown | Comment                                                                 |
|---------------|------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Ghost Form    | 15   | You go in your ghost form for 8 seconds. You can fly, are invisibile and can go throught the blocks | 12 s     |                                                                         |
| Invisibility  | 15   | You go invisible. To deactivate the invisibility just sneak when selecting this ability | 0.5 s    |                                                                         |
| Hybrid Form   | ∅    | Turn you into your hybrid from                                               | ∅        | ∅                                                                       |
| Haunting      | 10   | You call upon the other spirits to haunt your target                         | 15 s     | Haunting in 4 times, see below                                          |
| Possesion     | 20   | You take possession over your target. Don't work with player, to deactivate sneak when selecting this ability. Give you the bonus of the mob. If the mob can fly, you will be able to fly (selecting slot 5) | 20 s     |                                                                         |

---

### Form Hybrid

| Abilities        | Cost | Description                                                                                     | Cooldown | Comment |
|------------------|------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|---------|
| Ectoplasmic Ray  | 10   | Shot a Ectoplasmic ray dealing 10 magic damage and giving weaking for 10 s to the target        | 1.5 s    | ∅       |
| Mind Reading     | 10   | Use your spiritual connection to read the mind of the nearest entity and knowing its position and health. Give an effect of glowing for the entity in a distance of maximum 15 blocks. Give you the detail of the life and position of the nearest entity | 2.5 s    |         |
| Flight           | ∅    | Allow you to fly when sneaking. Jump and sneak to activate the fly                              | ∅        | ∅       |
| Normal Form      | ∅    | Turn back into your normal form                                                                 | ∅        | ∅       |
| Ecto-vision      | ∅    | Your ghost physiology allow you to see in the dark                                              | ∅        | ∅       |
| Ecto-body        | ∅    | In your hybrid form your body become visible and intangible. You don't take any damage nor the hunger trigger you. | ∅        | ∅       |
| Slow Recovery    | ∅    | In the Hybrid form, your spectral energy is regenerating more slowly than in Normal form or the power off. | ∅        | 1 Energy each 4 seconds |

---

## How to use the abilities
To activate/deactivate the power you just drop the power off/on.  

The datapack use a system of sneak + selecting a slot to activate/deactivate the abilities.  
It start from the first slot (0).  


![menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a053e0a5a43da53ce97717ef42a65d19cc34049_0.webp)
(cf how to use abilities picture)


To help you know wich abilities you will use it will be colored in a lighter shade.  

---

## Cooldown
After using an ability, you will have a short cooldown before using it again. The cooldown is represented by the color red.  

![cooldown](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d786c63ef6467f833a2572ea7fabc5938a1ce2e2_0.webp)

*(cf cooldown picture - Here I'm selecting Hybrid Form and all the other abilities are in cooldown)*  

---

## Haunting
The haunting abilities work in 4 times and have different effect:  

- **First effect when activating the ability**  
  - 8 lightning bolt damage  
  - weakness, slowness, mining fatgue, nausea, darkness, hunger  
  - bad omen infinite  

- **2nd haunting happen after 20 second**  
  - 8 lightning bolt damage  
  - levitation, nausea, darkness, slowness, weakness, mining fatigue  

- **3rd haunting happen after 60 second**  
  - 10 lightning bolt damage  
  - weakness, mining fatigue, slowness, hunger  

- **4th haunting (and last) happen after 120 second**  
  - 8 lightning bolt damage  
  - weakness, slowness, wither, mining fatgue, nausea, darkness, hunger
